info.name: atrium
info.description: CubeCart's default skin. Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js, built as a clean canvas for your own design.
info.creator: CubeCart

setting.name: google_font
setting.label: Font
setting.description: The typeface for the whole storefront. Skin default is Figtree, which ships with the skin and is served from your own site. Choosing one of the others loads it from Google instead, which adds a request to Google on every page, checkout included, and sends your visitors' IP addresses to them.

setting.name: main_menu_layout
setting.label: Main Menu
setting.description: Where the category menu sits on desktop. Vertical moves it to a rail down the left of the page instead of the band under the header. Phones and tablets use the slide-out drawer either way.

setting.name: brand_colour
setting.label: Brand Colour
setting.description: Your brand colour, for buttons, links, focus rings and price accents. This replaces the skin's sub-theme colour, so leave it empty unless none of the sub-themes is close enough to your brand.

setting.name: secondary_colour
setting.label: Header Colour
setting.description: Repaints the navigation band under the header, which no sub-theme touches. Leave empty to keep the near-black default.

setting.name: footer_colour
setting.label: Footer Colour
setting.description: Repaints the footer band on its own. Leave empty to keep the near-black default, whatever the header is set to.

setting.name: show_quick_view
setting.label: Show Quick View
setting.description: Show a Quick View button on product listings, which opens the product in a window without leaving the page. Hidden on phones either way, where the product page is a better experience than a modal.

setting.name: show_listing_add_to_basket
setting.label: Show Add to Basket on Listings
setting.description: Show the quantity box and Add to Basket button on category pages, the home page and other product listings. Turn this off to send customers to the product page first, which suits stores whose products have options or need explaining.

setting.name: show_basket_total
setting.label: Show Basket Total
setting.description: Show the basket total beside the basket icon in the header. Hidden on small screens either way, where there is no room for it.

setting.name: show_basket_count
setting.label: Show Basket Item Count
setting.description: Show the number of items as a badge on the basket icon. With this off, a basket with something in it is still shown by a filled icon.

setting.name: show_company_name
setting.label: Show Company Name
setting.description: Show the company name field on address and checkout forms.

setting.name: show_mobile_field
setting.label: Show Mobile Number
setting.description: Show the optional mobile number field on checkout and registration.

setting.name: show_order_comments
setting.label: Show Delivery Notes or Additional Comments
setting.description: Show the free-text comments box at the end of checkout. Existing comments still appear on orders and receipts when this is off.

setting.name: show_mailing_list
setting.label: Show Subscribe to Mailing List
setting.description: Show the newsletter opt-in on checkout. Has no effect when the store's newsletter is switched off in Store Settings.

setting.name: low_stock_threshold
setting.label: Low Stock Warning
setting.description: Show "Only 2 left in stock" on the product page once the real stock level drops to this number or below. Only ever shows the true figure, and only for products you track stock on. Works on its own: you do not have to switch on Display Stock Levels and publish an exact count on every product.

setting.name: show_recently_viewed
setting.label: Show Recently Viewed
setting.description: Show a row of the products this visitor looked at recently. The list is kept in their own browser and is never sent to the store or to anyone else.

setting.name: celebrate_coupon
setting.label: Celebrate Discount Codes
setting.description: Play a short burst of confetti over the basket when a customer successfully applies a discount code. Nothing is shown when a code is rejected, and visitors who ask their device for reduced motion get the highlight without the confetti.

setting.name: show_coupon_code
setting.label: Show Promo Code Field
setting.description: Show the promo/discount code box on checkout. Codes already applied to the basket still show, so a customer can always see and remove one.

setting.name: show_featured
setting.label: Show Featured Products
setting.description: Show the Featured Products box in the storefront sidebar.

setting.name: show_best_sellers
setting.label: Show Best Sellers
setting.description: Show the Best Sellers box in the storefront sidebar.

setting.name: show_sale_items
setting.label: Show Sale Items
setting.description: Show the Sale Items box in the storefront sidebar. With all three sidebar boxes off the page content takes the full width.

setting.name: review_stars
setting.label: Show Review Stars
setting.description: Where star ratings appear. Listings show one score per card, which can be noisy on a large catalogue, so the default is the product page only.

setting.name: default_product_view
setting.label: Default Product View
setting.description: How category listings first appear. A customer who picks the other view keeps their choice on this device.

setting.name: registration_mode
setting.label: Checkout Registration
setting.description: Whether a customer may create an account while checking out. Existing customers can always log in, whichever is chosen.
